Check database, Redis and LLM providers. ?deep=true also makes a tiny real LLM call.

`async def`: runs on the event loop. Safe because everything below it awaits
(no blocking calls), so other requests keep being served while we wait.

post.description: Create an account and log in (403 if registration is closed, 409 if the email is taken).
401 'wrong email or password' for every failure; 429 after too many.
End the session on the server AND remove the cookie (works even if already logged out).

get.description: Who is logged in (401 if nobody). The React app calls this on start.

post.description:
Queue a research job and return it at once (202). Follow it with GET /api/jobs/{id}.
409 if you already have a research running; 429 if your daily LLM budget is used up.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api Jobs Get

get.description: Status, progress messages, the topic when done, the error when failed, and its LLM use.

Follow a job live (Server-Sent Events), instead of asking GET /api/jobs/{id} again and again.
A GET with the login cookie, so the browser's own EventSource can read it. The stream ends when the job
does, or after a minute (the browser then reconnects by itself): a short stream never blocks a server
reload or sits forever in a proxy.

200.description: event `job` (a JobInfo) now and after every change, until done or failed; keep-alive comments in between

post.description: Start a failed job again, as a NEW job (409 if it did not fail).

get.description: Your LLM use today (UTC) against your daily budget.

schema.title: Response List Topics Api Topics Get

get.description: The full report as JSON. 404 if it isn't yours or doesn't exist; 409 if it has no results yet.

post.description:
Queue claims + quality + connections + gaps for this topic. Checked BEFORE queueing: a topic that
isn't yours (404) or has no results yet (409) never becomes a job that fails later.

Answer from this topic's papers only; every sentence cites a passage whose quote code checked.
409 if the topic isn't prepared for questions yet; 429 if the daily budget is used up.

The same answer as /ask, but each step is sent the moment it happens (Server-Sent Events).
Budget (429), ownership (404) and readiness (409) are checked BEFORE the stream starts, so they still
come back as normal JSON errors. Once streaming, the status is already 200: a failure is an `error` event.

200.description: events: stage (searching, reading, writing, checking); while writing: text ({index, text}: a sentence so far), sentence ({index, part}: finished and checked; part null = dropped), reset (forget the preview); then done (the AskResult) or error ({detail})

post.description: Prepare a topic's papers for questions, as a background job (minutes on Gemini's free tier).

schema.title: Response List Chats Api Chats Get

get.description: Passages across your papers (or one topic's), by meaning and keywords. No LLM.

AnalyzedPaper.title: AnalyzedPaper
AnalyzedPaper.description: The analysis plus what CODE found when checking it.

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description: A CHECKED answer: every sentence points at a passage, and code checked its quote and numbers.

sample_size.title: Sample Size
sample_size.description: number of participants/subjects analysed; null if not applicable

statistics_reported.description: statistical tests with p-values or confidence intervals

effect_sizes.description: effect sizes reported (e.g. Cohen's d, eta squared)

Appraisal.title: Appraisal
Appraisal.description: How the study was done: the facts a quality checklist asks for (scored by code in 5.2).

question.title: Question
examples: What daily dose of creatine did the trials use?

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: what was measured, e.g. 'long head EMG amplitude'

factor.title: Factor
factor.description: what was varied or compared, e.g. 'narrow vs wide grip' or 'training (before vs after)'

population.title: Population
population.description: who or what was studied, e.g. '10 healthy young men'

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: how the outcome changed with the factor

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: exact passage from the paper that states this result

Claim.title: Claim
Claim.description: One result of a study, written so it can be compared with other papers' results.

Connection.title: Connection
Connection.description: A CHECKED group: the relation is computed by code, members point at real papers and claims.

DocumentInfo.title: DocumentInfo
DocumentInfo.description: The full text a paper was read from (steps 4.3/4.4).

EvidenceGaps.title: EvidenceGaps
EvidenceGaps.description: What this body of evidence is missing: found by code, optionally written up by the LLM.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: exact passage that shows it (needed for 'yes')

statement.title: Statement
statement.description: one key result, in plain words

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: exact passage copied from the paper text that supports it

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description: One key result, with the passage from the paper that supports it (step 4.5).

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: 2-4 sentences: what the evidence base is missing, using ONLY the facts given

next_studies.title: Next Studies
next_studies.description: concrete study ideas that would fill these gaps

GapWriteUp.title: GapWriteUp
GapWriteUp.description: What the LLM writes from the counted facts (it may not add gaps or numbers).

JobInfo.title: JobInfo
JobInfo.description: What a user sees about one of their jobs (CLI now, API in 7.2).

PaperAnalysis.title: PaperAnalysis
PaperAnalysis.description: What the LLM returns for ONE paper (step 5.1).

PaperDetail.title: PaperDetail
PaperDetail.description: Everything known about ONE selected paper of a topic.

PaperRecord.title: PaperRecord
PaperRecord.description:
One paper as returned by ONE source, converted to a common shape.
Every source client returns these, so services never see API-specific formats.

tldr.title: Tldr
tldr.description: one plain-English sentence with the main result

objective.title: Objective
objective.description: what the study set out to find

methods.title: Methods
methods.description: design, participants (how many, who), what was measured and how

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.description: limitations the authors themselves state; empty if none

why_relevant.title: Why Relevant
why_relevant.description: one sentence on how the paper relates to the research brief

PaperSummary.title: PaperSummary
PaperSummary.description: What the LLM returns for ONE paper (from the full text if we have it, else the abstract).

ProviderUsage.title: ProviderUsage
ProviderUsage.description: One LLM provider's share of a user's calls today: which provider did the work, and which one fails.

Readiness.title: Readiness
Readiness.description: Is a topic ready for questions? (passages + embeddings, step 7.6a)

ReportPaper.title: ReportPaper
ReportPaper.description: One selected paper with everything the report shows about it.

field.title: Field
field.description: main academic field, e.g. 'sports science', 'computer science', 'economics'

is_biomedical.title: Is Biomedical
is_biomedical.description: true if the topic belongs to medicine, biology, health, physiology or sports science

is_cs_math_physics.title: Is Cs Math Physics
is_cs_math_physics.description: true if the topic belongs to computer science, AI, mathematics, statistics or physics

research_brief.title: Research Brief
research_brief.description: one or two sentences: what the user wants to learn

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: 3 to 5 short search queries (3-8 words each) covering different angles; use technical terms and synonyms

ResearchPlan.title: ResearchPlan
ResearchPlan.description: The LLM's plan for searching a topic (planning step).

ResearchReport.title: ResearchReport
ResearchReport.description: The result of the research pipeline, rebuilt from the database (so it is always reproducible).

ResearchRequest.title: ResearchRequest
ResearchRequest.description: Length limits stop empty topics and pasted essays (prompt-injection hygiene).

SearchHit.title: SearchHit
SearchHit.description: A passage found by the Search page (no LLM).

SummarizedPaper.title: SummarizedPaper
SummarizedPaper.description: A summary plus what CODE knows about it: what it was based on, and any warnings.

TrustAssessment.title: TrustAssessment
TrustAssessment.description: How much to trust a paper as evidence: a level, a label, and the reasons (never a mystery number).

UsageInfo.title: UsageInfo
UsageInfo.description: A user's LLM use today (UTC) against their daily budget (step 7.4).

UserInfo.title: UserInfo
UserInfo.description: Who is logged in (never the password hash).
